The fossil was tentatively linked to Tachyglossidae. 這個化石被暫時歸到針鼴科。
Tachyglossus is the genus of the short-beaked echidna. 針鼴屬是短吻針鼴所屬的屬。
The zoo sign listed the animal as Tachyglossus. 動物園的標示牌把這種動物列為針鼴屬。
She found an old tachygraph in the desk drawer. 她在書桌抽屜裡找到一份舊速記稿。
The speech survives only as a rough tachygraph. 那場演說只以一份粗略的速記稿保存下來。
A tachygrapher recorded every word of the trial. 一名速記員記下了審判中的每一句話。
The senator spoke too fast for the tachygrapher. 參議員說得太快，讓速記員難以跟上。
The archive preserves tachygraphic notes from the debate. 檔案館保存了那場辯論的速記筆記。
He learned a tachygraphic system in college. 他在大學學過一套速記的系統。
This manual offers a tachygraphical guide for beginners. 這本手冊為初學者提供速記法的指南。
Several tachygraphical symbols appear in the margin. 邊欄裡出現了幾個速記法的符號。
The witness's remarks were taken tachygraphically. 證人的陳述是以速記方式記下的。
The lecture was tachygraphically recorded for review. 這場演講被以速記方式記錄下來以供複查。
The magazine hired a skilled tachygraphist. 那本雜誌聘請了一位熟練的速記者。
Every busy court once depended on a tachygraphist. 過去每個繁忙的法庭都仰賴速記者。
The school used a tachygraphometer during drills. 學校在練習時使用速記速度計。
A tachygraphometer can compare writing speed. 速記速度計可以比較書寫速度。
Tachygraphometry was part of the training program. 速記測速法曾是訓練課程的一部分。
Few students still study tachygraphometry today. 如今仍研究速記測速法的學生已經很少。
Tachygraphy helped reporters before recorders were common. 在錄音器普及之前，速記術幫助了記者。
She practiced tachygraphy every evening. 她每天晚上都練習速記術。
The geologist labeled the white crust tachyhydrite. 地質學家把那層白色結殼標記為易溶礦物這種物質。
Tachyhydrite breaks down fast in humid air. 這種易溶礦物這種物質在潮濕空氣中會很快分解。
The pamphlet promised tachyiatry for every cold. 那本小冊子宣稱每種感冒都有速治法。
Real doctors distrust claims of easy tachyiatry. 真正的醫師不信任那種輕易速治法的說法。
Tachylalia can make speech hard to follow. 語速過快症會讓言語難以跟上。
The therapist helped him manage tachylalia. 治療師幫助他控制語速過快症。
The cliff contained bands of dark tachylite. 懸崖中含有深色的玄武玻璃帶。
Tachylite forms when lava cools very quickly. 岩漿冷卻得非常快時會形成玄武玻璃。

meaning: 玄武玻璃；快速冷卻形成的黑色火山玻璃
sentences: The lava formed tachylyte where it cooled quickly. 熔岩快速冷卻的地方形成了玄武玻璃。
The black tachylyte had a smooth glassy surface. 那塊黑色玄武玻璃表面平滑而有玻璃光澤。
The core sample had a tachylytic margin. 岩心樣本有一圈玄武玻璃的邊緣。
A tachylytic texture suggests rapid cooling. 玄武玻璃的質地顯示出快速冷卻。
The surveyor checked the tachymeter before sunrise. 測量員在日出前檢查了速測儀。
A digital tachymeter reduced field errors. 數位速測儀減少了外業誤差。
They used tachymetric data to map the slope. 他們用速測資料來繪製斜坡地圖。
The tachymetric results matched the old map. 速測的結果與舊地圖相符。
Tachymetry works well on rough ground. 速測法在崎嶇地面上效果很好。
The students practiced tachymetry all afternoon. 學生們整個下午都在練習速測法。
Tachyphagia often leads to stomach discomfort. 進食過快症常會導致胃部不適。
He slowed down his meals to reduce tachyphagia. 他放慢吃飯速度以減少進食過快症。
Tachyphasia may appear during severe stress. 快語症可能在嚴重壓力下出現。
The clinician noted brief tachyphasia in the interview. 臨床醫師在訪談中記下了短暫的快語症。
Tachyphemia made her words tumble together. 語速失控症讓她的話擠成一團。
The report distinguishes tachyphemia from stuttering. 報告把語速失控症和口吃區分開來。
Tachyphrasia can blur clear meaning. 快速表述症會讓清楚的意思變得模糊。
He paused often to counter his tachyphrasia. 他經常停頓，以對抗自己的快速表述症。
Lack of sleep worsened her tachyphrenia. 睡眠不足讓她的思緒過速更嚴重。
The doctor monitored the patient's tachyphrenia carefully. 醫師仔細監測病人的思緒過速。
The child arrived with mild tachypnea. 那個孩子到院時有輕微的呼吸過速。
Tachypnea can be a sign of fever or pain. 呼吸過速可能是發燒或疼痛的徵象。
The teacher flashed letters with a tachyscope. 老師用速視器快速閃現字母。
A tachyscope trains fast visual recognition. 速視器可以訓練快速視覺辨識。
The village felt a brief tachyseism before dawn. 村莊在黎明前感受到短暫的急震。
The record separates the tachyseism from the later wave. 記錄把急震和後來的波動區分開來。
Tachysterol appears in studies of vitamin D chemistry. 速固醇出現在維生素 D 化學的研究中。
The chemist measured tachysterol under controlled light. 化學家在受控光線下測量了速固醇。
The monitor alarmed during an episode of tachysystole. 在一次心縮過速發作時監視器響起警報。
Doctors treated the tachysystole with medication. 醫師用藥物治療了心縮過速。
The toxin was described as tachythanatous. 那種毒素被描述為迅速致死的。
A tachythanatous dose leaves little time for help. 迅速致死的劑量幾乎不留求救時間。
The old text mentioned tachytomy in emergencies. 那本古老文獻提到緊急情況下的快速切開術。
Modern surgeons rarely use the term tachytomy. 現代外科醫師很少使用快速切開術這個說法。
The printer bought a tachytype for the workshop. 印刷工為工坊買了一台快速排字機。
A tachytype once saved hours of labor. 快速排字機曾經節省好幾小時的勞力。

meaning: 默示的；未明說但可由沉默或行動推知的
sentences: Their silence was taken as tacit consent. 他們的沉默被視為默示同意。
The two partners reached a tacit agreement to share the work. 兩位夥伴達成了分工的默契協議。
His history has a dry, Tacitean tone. 他的歷史著作帶有乾峻的塔西佗式語調。
The essay ends with a Tacitean judgment on power. 那篇文章以一種塔西佗式的方式評斷權力。
They tacitly accepted the new rule. 他們心照不宣地接受了新規則。
She tacitly agreed by saying nothing. 她什麼都沒說，等於默默地同意了。
The deal relied on tacitness more than paperwork. 這筆交易更依賴默認而不是文件。
His tacitness confused the younger staff. 他的默認態度讓年輕員工感到困惑。
He is taciturn at meetings but thoughtful in writing. 他在會議上沉默寡言，但寫作時很有想法。
Her taciturn manner hid a warm personality. 她沉默寡言的樣子掩蓋了溫暖的性格。
The novel's hero is a lifelong taciturnist. 小說的主角是一名終生寡言者。
Even among friends, he remained a taciturnist. 即使在朋友之間，他仍是一個寡言者。
His taciturnity made interviews difficult. 他的緘默寡言讓訪談很困難。
The judge's taciturnity added tension to the room. 法官的緘默寡言讓房間更緊張。
She taciturnly nodded and sat down. 她寡言地點點頭，然後坐下。
He taciturnly thanked the team after the win. 獲勝後他寡言地向團隊道謝。

meaning: 化合物的黏性，與其內聚力和黏合性能有關。
sentences: The tape lost its tack after being used twice. 膠帶用過兩次後失去黏性。
Good tack helps the label stay on the bottle. 良好的黏性能讓標籤牢牢貼在瓶子上。
The carpenter reached for a wall tacker. 木工伸手去拿牆用釘固器。
A fast tacker finished the posters first. 動作快的釘固者最先把海報固定好。
A rusty tacket scratched the floor. 一枚生鏽的小釘刮傷了地板。
He pulled the old tacket from the boot. 他把靴子上的舊小釘拔了出來。
They rented a tackety cabin by the road. 他們租了路邊一間破舊俗氣的小屋。
The room looked tackety but felt welcoming. 房間看起來破舊俗氣，卻讓人感到親切。
The farmer bought a cheap tackey for short trips. 農夫買了一匹便宜的劣馬來短程代步。
He dressed like a tackey and ignored the jokes. 他穿得像個寒酸的人，卻不理會那些玩笑。
The paint still had some tackiness after an hour. 一小時後油漆仍有些黏膩。
They laughed at the tackiness of the bright sign. 他們笑那塊鮮豔招牌的俗氣。
The sailboat kept tacking against the wind. 那艘帆船一直迎著風之字轉向。
A few pins held the cloth before tacking. 在粗縫之前，有幾枚針先固定住布料。
The tailor tackingly joined the panels for fitting. 裁縫以臨時固定方式把幾片布接起來試穿。
The banner was tackingly attached to the frame. 旗幟被以臨時固定方式裝到框架上。
The government is introducing new measures to tackle environmental pollution. 政府正在推出新措施以應對（處理）環境污染。
The football player managed to tackle the opponent and stop the goal. 足球運動員成功擒抱住對手並阻止了進球。
The hardest issue is finally tackled. 最難的問題終於被處理了。
The runner fell after a tackled play. 那名跑者在一次被擒抱的進攻後倒下。
The fishermen returned tackleless after the storm. 暴風雨過後，漁民空著裝備回來了。
A tackleless cart stood beside the shed. 一輛沒有裝備的車停在棚子旁。
The tackleman checked every rope before launch. 裝備員在出發前檢查了每一條繩子。
Our old tackleman knew where every tool belonged. 我們那位老裝備員知道每件工具該放哪裡。
The tackler stopped the runner near the line. 擒抱者在邊線附近攔下了跑者。
She is a calm tackler of hard problems. 她是個冷靜處理難題的人。
We wanted a tackless wall for the gallery. 我們想讓畫廊的牆面保持無釘。
This tackless strip holds the carpet neatly. 這條無釘壓條把地毯固定得很整齊。
The players practiced tackling on soft mats. 球員們在軟墊上練習擒抱。
He packed his tackling before dawn. 他在黎明前收好了自己的裝備。
The coating becomes tackproof in a few minutes. 這層塗料幾分鐘後就會變得不黏手。
Leave the panels until the paint is tackproof. 先把板材放著，直到油漆變得不黏手。
The tacksman collected rents for the estate. 租佃承包人為那片莊園收取租金。
A tacksman could hold land under a long lease. 租佃承包人可以憑長期租約持有土地。
The paint is still tacky after an hour. 油漆過了一小時仍然有些黏。
The glittery decorations looked tacky in the small room. 那些閃亮裝飾在小房間裡看起來很俗氣。
The model marks a taclocus on the membrane. 這個模型在膜上標出一個接觸位點。
Mutation at the taclocus changed the reaction. 接觸位點上的突變改變了反應。
A tall tacmahack grew beside the bog. 沼澤旁長著一棵高大的落葉松。
The cabin was built from dry tacmahack boards. 那間小屋是用乾燥的落葉松木板建成的。
The curve forms a tacnode at the origin. 這條曲線在原點形成一個相切雙點。
She sketched the tacnode to explain the theorem. 她畫出相切雙點來解釋那個定理。
The geologist studied Taconian movement in the rocks. 地質學家研究岩石中的塔科尼期運動。
These layers may record a Taconian event. 這些地層可能記錄了一次塔科尼期事件。
They hiked along a Taconic ridge at sunrise. 他們在日出時沿著塔科尼克山脊健行。
The map highlights the Taconic range in green. 地圖用綠色標出了塔科尼克山脈。
Taconite became valuable when rich ore ran short. 當高品位礦石變少時，塔可岩變得有價值。
The plant processes taconite into iron pellets. 工廠把塔可岩加工成鐵礦球。

meaning: 安地斯西番蓮；一種藤本植物
sentences: In the valley, tacso climbs the fence and bears yellow fruit. 在山谷裡，安地斯西番蓮爬上籬笆，結出黃色果實。
The farmer planted tacso beside the cool stone wall. 農夫在陰涼的石牆旁種下安地斯西番蓮。
Tacsonia includes several passionflower vines from the Andes. 西番蓮屬包含數種安地斯山區的西番蓮藤本植物。
The gardener grew a Tacsonia vine along the sunny wall. 園丁讓一株西番蓮屬藤本植物沿著向陽的牆生長。
She handled the complaint with tact. 她很有分寸地處理投訴。
A little tact can prevent an argument. 一點機智和圓融可以避免爭吵。
The raised letters are tactable for blind readers. 這些凸起字母對盲人讀者來說是可觸知的。
We need a tactable surface on the control panel. 我們需要在控制面板上做出可觸知的表面。
She gave a tactful answer to a rude question. 她對那個無禮的問題給出了圓融得體的回答。
A tactful manager can correct people without shame. 圓融得體的主管可以在不讓人難堪的情況下糾正他人。
She answered tactfully when the guest complained. 她在客人抱怨時回應得很得體。
He tactfully changed the subject at dinner. 他在晚餐時圓融地換了話題。
Her tactfulness eased the tension in the room. 她的圓融緩和了房間裡的緊張氣氛。
Tactfulness is important in customer service. 圓融在客服工作中很重要。
That tactic saved the team valuable time. 那個策略為團隊省下了寶貴時間。
They used a simple tactic to attract attention. 他們用了一個簡單手法來吸引注意。

meaning: 戰術；為達成目標而採取的具體策略
sentences: The coach changed the team's tactic(s) before the final. 教練在決賽前改變了球隊的戰術。
The campaign used several tactic(s) to reach younger voters. 那場競選採用幾種策略來接觸年輕選民。

meaning: 戰術性的；涉及局部或短期行動的
sentences: The commander made a tactical withdrawal at dawn. 指揮官在黎明時進行戰術性撤退。
We need a tactical change to solve this immediate problem. 我們需要戰術性的調整來解決眼前的問題。
The army moved tactically through the valley. 軍隊策略性地穿過山谷。
She paused tactically before giving her answer. 她在回答前策略性地停頓了一下。
The coach was a brilliant tactician. 那位教練是出色的戰術家。
A skilled tactician knows when to wait. 熟練的戰術家知道何時該等待。
Their tactics confused the other side. 他們的戰術讓對方困惑。
Good tactics can overcome limited resources. 良好的戰術可以彌補資源有限。

meaning: 觸覺的；可藉觸摸感知的
sentences: The map uses tactile lines for people who cannot see. 這張地圖用觸覺線條幫助看不見的人辨識。
The child enjoyed the tactile texture of the clay. 那個孩子喜歡黏土的觸感。

meaning: 觸覺研究者；重視觸覺的人
sentences: The tactilist studied how people identify shapes by touch. 那位觸覺研究者研究人們如何靠觸摸辨認形狀。
As a tactilist, she trusted her fingers more than her eyes. 身為重視觸覺的人，她比起眼睛更相信手指。
The tactility of the fabric made it appealing. 這塊布料的觸感性讓它很吸引人。
Designers often care about tactility as much as color. 設計師常常和顏色一樣重視觸感性。

meaning: 觸覺學的；與觸摸辨識有關的
sentences: The report included a tactilogical description of the device. 報告中包含了這個裝置的觸覺學描述。
Researchers proposed a tactilogical test for blind users. 研究人員為盲人使用者提出了一項觸覺辨識測試。
The surface coating remained tactinvariant under light pressure. 這種表面塗層在輕壓下仍保持不受觸碰影響。
Engineers wanted a tactinvariant signal for the sensor. 工程師想要一種不受觸碰影響的感測訊號。
The sculpture invites taction rather than sight alone. 這件雕塑邀請人以觸覺而不只是視覺來感受。
Taction helps infants learn about texture. 觸覺有助於嬰兒認識質地。
The geologist found tactite near the old mine. 地質學家在舊礦坑附近發現了矽卡岩。
Tactite often forms where heat alters limestone. 矽卡岩常形成於熱作用改變石灰岩的地方。
The toy offers a tactive response when pressed. 這個玩具按下時會產生觸覺反應。
Patients described a tactive sensation in the fingertips. 病人描述指尖有一種觸覺性的感受。
His tactless joke offended the audience. 他那個不得體的笑話冒犯了觀眾。
It was tactless to mention money at the funeral. 在葬禮上提到錢是很失禮的。
She tactlessly laughed at his mistake. 她不得體地嘲笑了他的錯誤。
He tactlessly interrupted the speaker twice. 他失禮地兩次打斷講者。
Her tactlessness caused an avoidable argument. 她的不得體引發了一場本可避免的爭執。
People remembered his tactlessness more than his talent. 人們記得他的失禮勝過他的才華。
The lab used a tactometer to measure skin sensitivity. 實驗室使用觸覺測量器來測量皮膚敏感度。
A broken tactometer can ruin the experiment. 壞掉的觸覺測量器會毀掉實驗。

meaning: 觸覺致動器；觸感輸出器
sentences: The wristband contains a small tactor for alerts. 這條腕帶內含一個用於提醒的小型觸覺致動器。
Each tactor produced a different vibration pattern. 每個觸感輸出器都產生不同的震動模式。
The chemist recorded the behavior of the tactosol. 化學家記錄了這種觸變溶膠的行為。
Heat made the tactosol less stable. 加熱讓這種觸變溶膠變得較不穩定。
Blind readers rely on tactual information. 盲文讀者依賴觸覺資訊。
The exhibit encourages tactual exploration. 這個展覽鼓勵以觸覺方式探索。
The tactualist argued that touch shapes memory. 那位觸覺主義者主張觸摸會塑造記憶。
As a tactualist, he designed objects for the hand. 身為觸覺主義者，他為手部使用設計物件。
The artist emphasized the tactuality of clay. 那位藝術家強調黏土的可觸知性。
Modern screens reduce the tactuality of writing. 現代螢幕降低了書寫的觸覺性。
She judged the shape tactually in the dark. 她在黑暗中憑觸摸判斷形狀。
The sample was examined tactually before scanning. 樣本在掃描前先以觸覺方式檢查。
The conductor kept a steady tactus. 指揮維持了穩定的拍點。
Dancers followed the tactus of the drum. 舞者跟隨鼓聲的拍點。
Tacuacine was isolated from a tropical plant. 塔夸辛是從一種熱帶植物中分離出的。
The paper mentioned tacuacine only in passing. 那篇論文只順帶提到了塔夸辛。
Taculli arrived before the ceremony began. 塔庫利在典禮開始前抵達。
I sent the invitation to Taculli yesterday. 我昨天把邀請函寄給了塔庫利。
Tad left his umbrella by the door. 塔德把雨傘留在門邊。
I met Tad at the station after work. 我下班後在車站遇到塔德。
We need just a tad more salt. 我們只需要再多一點點鹽。
He was a tad nervous before the speech. 他在演講前有點緊張。
